Subject: Plan routing and addon mix for CloudPeak pilot

Hi Aditya / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We liked the latency profile and the ability to pin model variants per route. Before we move the pilot forward our finance and product teams want clarity on two things:

1) If we start on the Compact tier for pilot (to keep costs low) what is the exact uplift path to Standard / High-throughput? e.g., can we add burst pools, and how are those billed?

2) We expect to need the embeddings addon and a prefix-cache package for shared prompts. Can you describe how addons are bundled vs. charged separately? Will adding embeddings to Compact change our per-token rate or only add a flat monthly fee?

We have an internal procurement cadence next Friday; a short note that outlines upgrade steps and any seat/feature proration would help.

Appreciate it —
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Product | CloudPeak Health
maya@cloudpeak.com

Attachments: sample_generation_specs.pdf (ref)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@cloudpeak.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan routing and addon mix for CloudPeak pilot

Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the great session. Short answers up top, details below.

- Upgrade path: Compact -> Standard -> High is supported with instantaneous routing changes. Billing: base rate follows the tier; burst pools are metered as an add-on (GB-hours for reserved GPU burst) and show up as a separate line item. We can offer a one-time conversion credit for pilot customers that upgrade to Standard within 60 days.

- Addons: embeddings are billed per-embedding request (unit-based) as an addon; prefix/KV cache is a tiered feature. If you attach embeddings to Compact the per-token generation rate does not change, but the overall monthly invoice will include embeddings usage + any cache seat fees. Bundling (e.g., Compact + embeddings + prefix cache) can be given a blended discount if you commit to a 3-month pilot spend.

I've put an initial packaging matrix together and attached a two-page summary. Ben / Laura — can you confirm the pilot credit we can offer and whether the cache seat is a flat $/seat or a $/concurrent-sessions metric?

Next steps I suggest: 1) I put a 3-month pilot proposal with a 15% pilot bundle discount (subject to Ben's approval) 2) Laura will prepare a compact amendment with proration language 3) We sync on Friday 10am PT for procurement prep.

Best,
Aditya Rao

Subject: Re: Plan routing and addon mix for CloudPeak pilot

Aditya / Maya —

Quick follow — confirmed on the pricing levers: we can offer a 15% package-level discount for a 3-month pilot with an invoice credit equal to one month of Compact base fees applied if they convert to Standard within 60 days. Burst pools billed as metered GB-hr at the rate in the proposal; we can cap monthly burst spend for the pilot at $2,500 to limit surprises.

Cache seat: for pilots we charge a flat $350/month per cache seat (up to 5 seats). For scale customers we move to $/concurrent-sessions, but that's not necessary here.

I made a small edit to the proposal PDF (redwood-proposal-v2.pdf) to add the 60-day conversion credit and the burst cap. Laura — can you confirm the amendment/legal language for proration?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
ben_carter@redwood.com

Maya —

Looping in marketplace/legal language as requested. I attached a short amendment draft that covers proration, pilot discount terms, and the conversion credit mechanics. Highlights:

- Proration: if you upgrade mid-billing-cycle we prorate base tier fees by unused days and apply credits to the next invoice.
- Pilot discount: 15% off base+addons for pilot period (3 months).
- Conversion credit: one-month Compact base fee credited if they upgrade to Standard within 60 days of pilot start; credit applied within 30 days of upgrade confirmation.
- Burst cap: we will honor the $2,500 cap for the pilot; overages require approval.

If that aligns I can send the amendment to your procurement team and spin a DocuSign.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: amendment-pilot-proration.docx, packaging-matrix-cloudpeak.xlsx
